question.question: State Accept Contract and Dutiful Service’s Agent icons and effects with and without CHOAM, and whether both automatically advance a Faction track.

key.expected_answer: Accept Contract uses the Spice Trade Agent icon: draw one card and resolve a contract icon; it does not automatically gain Faction Influence. Dutiful Service uses the Emperor Agent icon: gain one Emperor Influence and resolve a contract icon. Without CHOAM each contract icon gives 2 Solari. With CHOAM, take an available public face-up contract into your supply and refill from the bank if possible; the icon gives 2 Solari if no such contract remains. For another human, Shaddam's unacquired set-aside Sardaukar contracts are unavailable and do not prevent this fallback when the public supply is empty. Shaddam's reserved-contract acquisition option remains governed by his Leader and the FAQ.
key.source_references: See benchmark-v17/source-reference-appendix.json: original main PDF pp16,20, Uprising Board Space Guide, original Shaddam Leader and official FAQ p3, exact named-file/hash locators.

a.answer: Accept Contract uses the Spice Trade icon, has no cost, always draws one card, and resolves the contract icon: without CHOAM gain 2 Solari; with CHOAM take an available public contract, or gain 2 Solari if offers are exhausted. It is not a Faction space and gives no automatic Influence. Dutiful Service uses the Emperor icon, has no cost, gains 1 Emperor Influence plus the same contract-icon effect; its automatic Emperor advance is that one Influence counted once.
a.evidence: Board Space Guide: shared contract icon rule and table for Accept Contract/Dutiful Service; contract spaces clarify faction status.

b.answer: Accept Contract is Spice Trade, no cost, no Combat: always draw one card and resolve contract icon (2 Solari without CHOAM; take public contract with CHOAM if available, else 2 Solari). It is not a Faction, so no automatic Influence. Dutiful Service is Emperor, no cost, no Combat: gain 1 Emperor Influence and resolve same contract icon; the Influence is counted once, not twice.
b.evidence: Board Space Guide; Human contract icon
